parameters.query:
INSERT INTO network_alarms
  (alarm_id, device_id, device_name, alarm_type, severity, interface_name, description, alarm_source, alarm_timestamp, raw_payload, processing_status)
VALUES (COALESCE(NULLIF($1, '')::uuid, gen_random_uuid()),
        (SELECT device_id FROM network_devices WHERE device_name = $2),
        $2, $3, $4, NULLIF($5, ''), $6, $7, $8::timestamptz, $9::jsonb, 'received')
ON CONFLICT (alarm_id) DO UPDATE SET updated_at = NOW()
RETURNING alarm_id, device_id, device_name, alarm_type, severity, interface_name, description, alarm_timestamp

SELECT (SELECT alarm_id FROM network_alarms
        WHERE device_name = $1 AND alarm_type = $2 AND alarm_id <> $3::uuid
          AND processing_status IN ('processing', 'processed')
          AND alarm_timestamp > NOW() - INTERVAL '5 minutes'
        ORDER BY alarm_timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) AS duplicate_of_alarm_id

WITH inc AS (
  INSERT INTO network_incidents (alarm_id, incident_title, severity, incident_status, affected_devices)
  VALUES ($1::uuid, $2, $3, 'investigating', jsonb_build_array($4::text))
  RETURNING incident_id
)
UPDATE network_alarms a SET processing_status = 'processing', incident_id = inc.incident_id
FROM inc WHERE a.alarm_id = $1::uuid
RETURNING inc.incident_id

UPDATE network_incidents SET
  incident_title = $2, severity = $3, probable_root_cause = $4,
  supporting_evidence = $5::jsonb, alternative_causes = $6::jsonb, confidence_estimate = NULLIF($7, '')::numeric,
  affected_devices = $8::jsonb, affected_services = $9::jsonb, impact_level = $10,
  recommended_actions = $11::jsonb, requires_human_approval = TRUE, incident_status = 'open',
  classification_result = $12::jsonb, rca_result = $13::jsonb, topology_result = $14::jsonb,
  remediation_result = $15::jsonb, full_report = $16, estimated_repair_time = NULLIF($17, '')
WHERE incident_id = $1::uuid
RETURNING incident_id, severity

options.queryReplacement: ={{ (i => [ i.incident_id, i.incident_title, i.severity, i.probable_root_cause, i.supporting_evidence, i.alternative_causes, String(i.confidence_estimate ?? ''), i.affected_devices, i.affected_services, i.impact_level, i.recommended_actions, i.classification_result, i.rca_result, i.topology_result, i.remediation_result, i.full_report, i.estimated_repair_time || '' ])($json.incident) }}
